name: Gwen
source: A young human, and one-time member of the Organisation. Gwen has spent her life unsure and searching for meaning, something or someone she can dedicate her life to. After [spoiler]the MC uses a full-power AWAKEN on her[/spoiler], she believes she has finally found that someone…
